description: Canonical 12-line time-bucketed PAL opening greeting contract (Feature 2.0, SPEC §2.0). Generated from the locked runtime source lib/features/pal/opening/pal_opening_lines.dart: 3 lines per time bucket (morning/afternoon/evening/night). This is the LIVE opening contract consumed by generate_pal_framing_audio_batch.sh 'opening' category. Supersedes the retired 60-line tone-bucketed manifest (OPENING_GENTLE/CALM/WARM/ENCOURAGING/WEARY), which had no runtime producers after Feature 2.0 — see git history for the prior version.

lines.text: Good morning… how's your day going so far?
What kind of day has it been?
What's today been like for you?
